Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the call today — great overview from your side. Quick recap from our end:
- ShopSpark is evaluating inference cost and latency for our Recommendations API (90M monthly requests, 200ms p95 target).
- Our main blockers are predictable per-request cost and a workable deployment plan across multi-region traffic.
- We want to validate a path to a two-week pilot (ingest subset, run traffic shadowing, measure unit economics).

We agreed the next concrete step is a short VP/CTO alignment so our leadership can confirm runway and procurement. Can Redwood provide a 30–40m slot next week that covers: tech tradeoffs (quantization / batching), pilot KPIs, and contract/timing expectations?

Proposed attendees from our side: Alex Ramos (me), Maya Singh (security/infra lead).

Looking for a few options — we are U.S. Pacific TZ. Happy to lock anything on Mon/Tue morning PT.

Appreciate it,
Alex
ShopSpark
